Transport Documents

Étiquette de cargaison

A physical or electronic tag affixed to cargo or packaging, containing essential shipment details such as consignee, origin, destination, handling instructions, and identification codes for logistics tracking and customs clearance.

Quick answer: A physical or electronic tag affixed to cargo or packaging, containing essential shipment details such as consignee, origin, destination, handling instructions, and identification codes for logistics tracking and customs clearance.

Questions and answers

Questions and answers

What is Étiquette de cargaison?

In this glossary, Étiquette de cargaison refers to: A physical or electronic tag affixed to cargo or packaging, containing essential shipment details such as consignee, origin, destination, handling instructions, and identification codes for logistics tracking and customs clearance.

How is Étiquette de cargaison used in logistics?

In logistics communication, this term appears in contexts such as: "Tous les colis doivent porter une étiquette de cargaison indiquant le destinataire et l'adresse de destination pour se conformer aux exigences du transporteur et des douanes."

Why does Étiquette de cargaison matter in logistics?

Étiquette de cargaison matters because it supports clear communication in Transport Documents contexts for Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers. It also connects to aviation training and exam language such as FIATA Diploma, CILT Certification, and IATA DGR.

Who uses Étiquette de cargaison?

Étiquette de cargaison is mainly used by Freight Forwarders, Supply Chain Managers, and Customs Brokers.

What category does Étiquette de cargaison belong to?

In this glossary, Étiquette de cargaison is grouped under Transport Documents. Related pages in this category explain adjacent procedures, commands and operational concepts.

Where does this definition come from?

This definition is sourced from Incoterms 2020 (ICC), FIATA, IATA DGR, WCO and published by Protermify Logistics as a static logistics reference page.

Definition

A physical or electronic tag affixed to cargo or packaging, containing essential shipment details such as consignee, origin, destination, handling instructions, and identification codes for logistics tracking and customs clearance.

Operational example

All packages must display a cargo label showing the consignee and destination address for compliance with carrier and customs requirements.

Localized term

Étiquette de cargaison

Localized example

Tous les colis doivent porter une étiquette de cargaison indiquant le destinataire et l'adresse de destination pour se conformer aux exigences du transporteur et des douanes.
